verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's site claims an ecosystem of 3,900+ providers and 23,600+ modules for managing infrastructure "across every cloud platform". It shows SaaS-style use cases such as DNS configuration and GitHub repository and team management, and it is positioned as a drop-in Terraform replacement. Community comments confirm it runs on the upstream provider ecosystem and that migration is a simple swap. missing for 10: in-depth provider registry documentation naming specific major clouds and SaaS providers, and independent hands-on corroboration of how broad and compatible provider coverage really is.
